_comment: The Trusted Signing account, in the form CI needs.
The copy at the repository root (artifact-signing-metadata.json) is
git-ignored: it is the file a developer points at their own `az login`
session. A runner has no such file, so it needs one that is committed.
The account and profile names are not secrets; the authorisation to use
them is (an Azure federated credential trusting
Same account and certificate profile as Nullgate (steeb-k/nullgate,
`azure/login` authenticates with a GitHub OIDC token and then runs
`az login`, so what a runner ends up holding is an Azure CLI session -
exactly like a laptop. It does NOT set the environment that
EnvironmentCredential or WorkloadIdentityCredential read, so those stay
excluded along with everything interactive: a credential type that can
open a browser has no business in a non-interactive job, where it would
hang until the step times out.
